entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hello, Charlie. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Got it. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered about 84 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats multiple times, but they just give me terrible blisters on any ride longer than an hour. I really wanted to like these shoes.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for you. Let me just quickly confirm the return eligibility. One moment.
Alright, I've checked the policy. Since the item was delivered 84 days ago, it's still within our 90-day window for a return. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.

Oh, that's excellent news. Thank you. Now, since I've had to hold onto them for a while and go through this trouble, is there any chance you could add a small discount code to my account for a future purchase? I still need a new pair, and I'd like to stick with VeloFit.

I'm glad we could get that refund approved for you. While I can't offer a discount code in addition to the full refund, I can assure you the return process will be simple. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email right now. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed.
Okay, that's fair. The refund is the most important part. I appreciate you making it easy. I'll look for that email.
It's been sent. You should have it within the next few minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
